name: English - Great Minds in Science and Technology C1
description: Trust in science has been diminishing over the last 20 years or so, in part due to debates surrounding climate change. In this module, questions regarding what science can and cannot do will be discussed, as well as more basic questions like what is science? why is science sometimes under attack? should it be trusted (and why or why not)? and how does science progress? The discussion of these topics will be guided by reading texts by well-known philosophers of science including Thomas Kuhn, Richard Feynman, Jim Al-Khalili – and Naomi Oreskes, among others.
prerequisites: B2 or C1 English and an interest in science
